entries.title: A new InkyBay website
entries.text: We rebuilt the InkyBay website so it is easier to see what InkyBay does and how it fits your store.
items: A page for each of the nine features, with live examples of how they work
Eight industry pages, from fashion and apparel to gadgets and electronics
A blog with practical guides on print preparation, pricing and growth
A partner directory, a new contact page and a pricing page with every plan

entries.title: InkyBay launches on the Shopify App Store
entries.text: InkyBay Product Personalizer is listed on the Shopify App Store, giving merchants a live design editor so shoppers can create and preview their own custom products.
